snippet.title: BioMenace Remastered - Free Demo! - FRIDAY JULY 11th!
snippet.description:
The official announcement for the BioMenace Remastered Demo that comes out Friday the 11th of July! This way you can enjoy the feeling of the Remaster while we continue our work on the fourth episode.

Wishlist the game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3459100/BioMenace_Remastered

Join the Rigel Gameworks Discord:
https://discord.gg/PGTJ9H2wCk
